description.value: Bayshore Waterfront Inn sits at the Inner Harbour of Ucluelet Marina, offering direct views of the harbour, mountains, and wildlife including sea lions, seals, and eagles. The property offers multiple room types—from standard queen rooms to two-bedroom suites with full kitchens, electric fireplaces, and barbecue patios. Ucluelet is a gateway to Pacific Rim National Park and the Broken Group Islands, making this inn a natural base for touring cyclists exploring the west coast of Vancouver Island.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content was successfully fetched and is the primary evidence source. The about page confirms free WiFi, kitchen suites, and electric fireplaces, and the two-bedroom room detail page lists amenity icons including 'Free Wifi'. No mention of bike storage, bike procedures, laundry, drying area, e-bike charging, or any cycling-specific facilities appears anywhere on the site. The website has placeholder Lorem ipsum text in several room description sections, suggesting the site is partially built out but the contact and location information is consistent with OSM.
concerns: Multiple room description sections contain placeholder Lorem ipsum text, indicating the website is not fully complete.
No cycling-specific amenities (bike storage, tools, wash area, e-bike charging) mentioned anywhere on the site.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate operational inn in a high-value cycling destination, but the website contains no evidence of secure bike storage or any cycling-specific facilities required for WWC accreditation. Direct outreach is needed to determine whether the property can accommodate touring bikes before inclusion.
